data.name: Satyabhama
data.gender_notes: Satyabhama is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit satya, 'truth', + bhāmā, 'lustre' — Satyabhāmā. Its root is Sanskrit satya + bhāmā. Satyabhama, wife of Krishna. Satyabhama is a Sanskrit name meaning “True lustre; Krishna's wife”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Satyabhama expresses “True lustre; Krishna's wife”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit satya, 'truth', + bhāmā, 'lustre' — Satyabhāmā.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Satyabhama total 28, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
